_: Crash clusters whose CAUSE has been fixed in the repo but whose fix has not reached users. A crash with a fix in hand is a different thing from one nobody has looked at: the action is no longer 'fix it', it is 'ship it'. Keyed by the Play Console issue id (the hash in its issueUri). Remove an entry once the cluster stops appearing on a build at or above `build`. `versionCode` is the first ANDROID release carrying the fix (the Apple `build` is not comparable to it); the page compares it to the Play production and in-flight versionCodes.
